lessons.title: Greetings
lessons.goal: Say hello, goodbye, thank you and sorry.

lessons.title: Who are you?
lessons.goal: Say your name, nationality and job with 是 and 叫.

lessons.title: How are you?
lessons.goal: Ask yes / no questions with 吗 and bounce them back with 呢.

lessons.title: When you don't understand
lessons.goal: Ask to repeat, slow down, explain or write it down.

lessons.title: This and that
lessons.goal: Point at things and people; say whose they are with 的.

lessons.title: My family
lessons.goal: Talk about family members with 有 / 没有 and count them.

lessons.title: Age and jobs
lessons.goal: Ask and give age and job; say where you work with 在.

lessons.title: Describing people
lessons.goal: Describe people with 很, 太……了, 真 and 不太.

lessons.title: Numbers 0 to 99
lessons.goal: Count, and ask "how many" with 几 and 多少.

lessons.title: Big numbers and phone numbers
lessons.goal: Hundreds, thousands, 万; read phone and room numbers.

lessons.title: Measure words
lessons.goal: Count things with the right measure word.
patterns: 这 / 那 + measure word + noun

lessons.title: How much and which one
lessons.goal: Some, a little, every, both; pick the one you want.

lessons.title: What time is it?
lessons.goal: Tell the time; opening hours; arrange a time.
patterns: 点 / 分 / 半 / 刻 / 差

lessons.title: Days of the week
lessons.goal: Days, this week and next, when you are free.

lessons.title: Dates and birthdays
lessons.goal: Say dates, years and birthdays; ask when with 是……的.

lessons.title: Parts of the day, how long
lessons.goal: Morning to evening; say how long something takes.
patterns: day → part of day → clock time

lessons.title: Where is it?
lessons.goal: Ask where people and places are with 在 and 哪儿.
patterns: 哪儿 / 这儿 / 那儿

lessons.title: On, in, under, next to
lessons.goal: Say where things are; say what is somewhere with 有.
patterns: A 在 + noun + 上 / 里 / 下面 / 旁边

lessons.title: Places in town
lessons.goal: Say where you are going, where you live, where you do things.

lessons.title: Near and far
lessons.goal: Say how far a place is and describe it.
patterns: A 离 B 远 / 近
这里 / 那里 / 哪里

lessons.title: My day
lessons.goal: Describe your daily routine in time order.

lessons.title: What are you doing?
lessons.goal: Say what is happening now with 在 and 正在.

lessons.title: Weekend plans
lessons.goal: Make plans and suggestions; choose with 还是.

lessons.title: Habits
lessons.goal: Say how often you do things.
patterns: 常常 / 有时候 / 一般

lessons.title: Food I like
lessons.goal: Say what you like to eat and drink.

lessons.title: I want, I'd like
lessons.goal: Ask for food and drink with 要 and 想; say no politely.

lessons.title: Tastes and cooking
lessons.goal: Describe tastes; say what you do not eat.

lessons.title: Meals at home
lessons.goal: Talk about meals; accept and refuse more food.

lessons.title: Getting a table
lessons.goal: Understand the host; say how many you are; reservations.

lessons.title: Ordering
lessons.goal: Call the waiter, ask for the menu and a recommendation, order.

lessons.title: During the meal
lessons.goal: Ask for things at the table; sort out a wrong dish.

lessons.title: Paying the bill
lessons.goal: Ask for the bill, pay by phone or card, treat or split.

lessons.title: How much is it?
lessons.goal: Ask prices, hear them, and haggle a little.

lessons.title: Buying clothes
lessons.goal: Look around, try things on, ask for sizes and colours.

lessons.title: At the checkout
lessons.goal: Pay, get change, refuse a bag, return or exchange.

lessons.title: Online, in malls and markets
lessons.goal: Talk about online orders, sales and sold-out items.

lessons.title: Done: verb + 了
lessons.goal: Say what you did and did not do.

lessons.title: Things have changed
lessons.goal: Say that a situation is new, has changed or is about to happen.

lessons.title: How, when, with whom: 是……的
lessons.goal: Ask and give details of past events.

lessons.title: Telling a story
lessons.goal: Tell what happened in order, and for how long.

items.note: 3rd + 3rd tone: the first 3rd tone is spoken as a 2nd: ní hǎo.
您 is the polite "you": for older people, teachers and customers.
们 makes a plural of people: 你们 = you (plural).
Title after the name or alone: 王老师好！
The second 谢 is in the neutral tone: short and light.
不 is bù, but bú before a 4th tone (客 kè).
The usual answer to 对不起.
是 links two nouns: A 是 B = A is B.
不是 bú shì: 不 rises before the 4th tone of 是.
他 (he) and 她 (she) sound the same: tā.

items.ruby: 你[nǐ]叫[jiào]什么[shén me]名字[míng zi]？

items.note: Put your own name after 叫.
A polite question; answer with 我姓 + surname.
Country + 人 = a person from there.

items.ruby: 认识[rèn shi]你[nǐ]很[hěn]高兴[gāo xìng]。
items.note: 很 before an adjective is often just a link, not "very".
Three 3rd tones in a row: usually spoken wó yé hěn.
Correct but a little formal; friends say 最近怎么样？
Three 3rd tones: usually spoken wó hén hǎo.
呢 bounces the question back: "and you?"
也 (also) goes before the verb or adjective, never at the end.
3rd + 3rd tone: the first 3rd tone is spoken as a 2nd: ké yǐ.
不太 bú tài = not very.

items.ruby: 最近[zuì jìn]怎么样[zěn me yàng]？

items.note: 挺……的 = quite. 3rd + 3rd tone: the first 3rd tone is spoken as a 2nd: tíng hǎo.

items.ruby: 你[nǐ]是[shì]中国人[Zhōng guó rén]吗[ma]？
items.note: Add 吗 to any statement to make a yes / no question.

items.ruby: 不[bù]，我[wǒ]是[shì]英国人[Yīng guó rén]。

items.note: Chinese has no single word for "yes": repeat the verb (是 / 有 / 会) or say 对.
Verb + 不 + result: 听不懂 = listen but not understand. 不 here is neutral.
一 is yī, but yí before a 4th tone (遍 biàn).

items.ruby: 请[qǐng]说[shuō]慢[màn]一点儿[yì diǎn r]。
items.note: 一点儿 yìdiǎnr: 一 is yì before a 1st, 2nd or 3rd tone. The 儿 ending is northern; in the south people say 一点.

items.en: How do you say this in Chinese?
items.ruby: 这个[zhè ge]用[yòng]中文[Zhōng wén]怎么[zěn me]说[shuō]？
这[zhè]是[shì]什么[shén me]意思[yì si]？

items.en: I can speak a little Chinese.
items.ruby: 我[wǒ]会[huì]说[shuō]一点儿[yì diǎn r]中文[Zhōng wén]。
items.note: 会 = can, a skill you have learned.
Answer with the verb of the question: 会 / 不会.
Verb + 一下 (yíxià) softens a request: "just ... a bit".

items.en: Excuse me, are you Teacher Wang?
items.ruby: 请问[qǐng wèn]，你[nǐ]是[shì]王[Wáng]老师[lǎo shī]吗[ma]？
items.kana: qingwen ni shi wang laoshi ma
items.romaji: Qǐngwèn, nǐ shì Wáng lǎoshī ma?
items.note: 请问 = "may I ask": the polite way to start a question to a stranger.
的 links owner and thing: 我的书 = my book.
谁 is shéi in everyday speech (shuí when read carefully).
With close people 的 is usually dropped: 我朋友, 我妈妈.
我的 alone = mine.

items.kana: zhe shi ni de shouji ma
items.romaji: Zhè shì nǐ de shǒujī ma?

items.note: 这 zhè = this (near), 那 nà = that (far).

items.en: How many people are there in your family?
items.kana: ni jia you ji kou ren
items.romaji: Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén?
items.note: 口 (mouth) is the measure word for family members.

items.en: There are four of us in my family.
items.kana: wo jia you si kou ren
items.romaji: Wǒ jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén.

items.en: Dad, Mum, my younger sister and me.
items.ruby: 爸爸[bà ba]、妈妈[mā ma]、妹妹[mèi mei]和[hé]我[wǒ]。
items.note: Kinship words double the syllable; the second one is neutral.

items.en: Do you have brothers or sisters?
items.ruby: 你[nǐ]有[yǒu]兄弟姐妹[xiōng dì jiě mèi]吗[ma]？

items.note: 一个 yí ge: 个 was originally gè (4th), so 一 rises.
有 is negated with 没, never with 不.
Written nǚ'ér: an apostrophe goes before a syllable that starts with a, o or e.
两 (not 二) before a measure word.

items.en: How old are you? (to an adult)
items.note: To a child: 你几岁了？ To an older person: 您多大年纪了？
No 是 before an age.

items.en: How old are you? (to a child)

items.ruby: 你[nǐ]做[zuò]什么[shén me]工作[gōng zuò]？
我[wǒ]在[zài]公司[gōng sī]工作[gōng zuò]。
items.note: The place (在 + place) comes before the verb.

items.ruby: 她[tā]在[zài]医院[yī yuàn]工作[gōng zuò]。
你[nǐ]在[zài]哪儿[nǎ r]工作[gōng zuò]？
items.note: 哪儿 nǎr (north) = 哪里 nǎli (south).
Adjectives need no 是: 他很高, never 他是高.
3rd + 3rd tone: the first 3rd tone is spoken as a 2nd: hén hǎo.

items.en: Your little sister is very cute.
items.ruby: 你[nǐ]妹妹[mèi mei]很[hěn]可爱[kě ài]。

items.note: 太 + adjective + 了 = "so ...!" (or "too ...").
Literally "her friends are many".
多 + adjective = how ... ?
一米八 = 1.80 m; the unit for the second part is left out.
When counting, 一 keeps its 1st tone: yī.
四 sì and 十 shí sound close: s versus sh.
11-19: 十 + digit.
二 èr when counting; 两 liǎng + measure word: 两个人.
个 is the all-purpose measure word.
一个 yí ge: 一 rises before 个.

items.en: How many children do you have?
items.note: 几 expects a small number and needs a measure word; 多少 is for any number.

items.en: How many of you are there?
items.ruby: 你们[nǐ men]有[yǒu]多少[duō shao]人[rén]？

items.note: 一 is yì before a 1st, 2nd or 3rd tone.
零 fills a gap: 一百零五 = 105.
Also 二百.
万 = 10,000: Chinese groups big numbers by four digits.
The last unit is often dropped: 三万五 = 三万五千.

items.ruby: 你[nǐ]的[de]电话[diàn huà]号码[hào mǎ]是[shì]多少[duō shao]？
items.kana: ni de dianhua haoma shi duoshao
items.romaji: Nǐ de diànhuà hàomǎ shì duōshao?

items.ruby: {138|yāo sān bā} {1234|yāo èr sān sì} {5678|wǔ liù qī bā}。
items.kana: yao san ba yao er san si wu liu qi ba
items.romaji: Yāo sān bā yāo èr sān sì wǔ liù qī bā.
items.tts: 幺三八，幺二三四，五六七八。
items.note: In phone and room numbers 1 is read yāo, so it is not confused with 七 qī.
Room numbers are read digit by digit.
第 + number = ordinal; 一 keeps yī.

items.en: This is my second time in China.
items.ruby: 这[zhè]是[shì]我[wǒ]第二[dì èr]次[cì]来[lái]中国[Zhōng guó]。
items.kana: zhe shi wo dier ci lai zhongguo
items.romaji: Zhè shì wǒ dì'èr cì lái Zhōngguó.

items.ruby: 百分之[bǎi fēn zhī]五十[wǔ shí]
items.note: Hundred-parts-of fifty: the whole comes first.
Between a number and a noun there is always a measure word. 本 is for books.
杯 = cup, glass.
张 is for flat things: tickets, paper, tables, beds.
件 is for tops and coats, and for matters: 一件事.
条 is for long things: trousers, roads, rivers, fish.
只 is for most animals.
位 is the polite measure word for people.
这 / 那 also need a measure word: 这个人, 那本书.
items.pattern: 这 / 那 + measure word + noun

items.note: 辆 is for vehicles.
双 is for pairs: shoes, socks, chopsticks.

items.en: How many bottles do you want?

items.note: The measure word can stand alone when the noun is clear.
一些 = some (a few or a bit); no other measure word needed.
每 + measure word + noun.
天 is its own measure word: 每天, not 每个天.
很多 + noun needs no measure word.

items.en: How many of you are there?

items.note: 碗 = bowl.
块 = piece (cake, soap); in speech also = yuan.
份 = a portion or a copy.
哪 nǎ = which; 那 nà = that. Many people say něi ge.
都 (all, both) goes before the verb.
Two o'clock is 两点, never 二点.
一刻 = a quarter of an hour; 三刻 = three quarters.
差 = short of.

items.en: What time does the shop open?
items.ruby: 商店[shāng diàn]几[jǐ]点[diǎn]开门[kāi mén]？

items.en: It opens at nine in the morning.
items.ruby: 早上[zǎo shang]九[jiǔ]点[diǎn]开门[kāi mén]。

items.en: It closes at ten in the evening.
items.ruby: 晚上[wǎn shang]十[shí]点[diǎn]关门[guān mén]。
我们[wǒ men]几[jǐ]点[diǎn]见面[jiàn miàn]？
items.note: Time words go before the verb, never at the end.

items.ruby: 我们[wǒ men]三[sān]点[diǎn]见面[jiàn miàn]吧[ba]。
items.note: 吧 at the end makes a suggestion: "let's ...".
五分 = five past (clock time); 五分钟 = five minutes (duration).
一个小时 = one hour.

items.ruby: 今天[jīn tiān]星期三[xīng qī sān]。
items.note: Monday to Saturday: 星期一 to 星期六 (1 to 6). No 是 needed.
一 keeps yī here: it is a number in a name.
Also 星期日 (more formal).

items.ruby: 明天[míng tiān]是[shì]星期六[xīng qī liù]。

items.note: 上个星期 = last week; 下个星期 = next week.

items.ruby: 你[nǐ]什么[shén me]时候[shí hou]有[yǒu]空[kòng]？

items.note: 空 kòng = free time; kōng = empty.

items.ruby: 星期五[xīng qī wǔ]晚上[wǎn shang]怎么样[zěn me yàng]？
今天[jīn tiān]十一月[shí yī yuè]二十一[èr shí yī]号[hào]。
items.note: Big unit first: year, month, day. 号 in speech, 日 in writing.
Months are just numbers: 一月 to 十二月.
Years are read digit by digit.

items.ruby: 你[nǐ]的[de]生日[shēng rì]是[shì]几[jǐ]月[yuè]几[jǐ]号[hào]？
items.kana: ni de shengri shi ji yue ji hao
items.romaji: Nǐ de shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào?

items.kana: ni shi na nian chusheng de
items.romaji: Nǐ shì nǎ nián chūshēng de?
items.note: 是……的 asks about the details of a past event: when, where, how.

items.ruby: 我[wǒ]是[shì]{1995|yī jiǔ jiǔ wǔ}年[nián]出生[chū shēng]的[de]。
items.kana: wo shi yi jiu jiu wu nian chusheng de
items.romaji: Wǒ shì yī jiǔ jiǔ wǔ nián chūshēng de.
items.tts: 我是一九九五年出生的。

items.en: The Spring Festival is the Chinese New Year.
items.ruby: 春节[Chūn jié]是[shì]中国[Zhōng guó]的[de]新年[xīn nián]。

items.note: 早上 = early morning; 上午 = the rest of the morning.

items.ruby: 明天[míng tiān]下午[xià wǔ]三[sān]点[diǎn]
items.note: Order: day, part of day, clock time.
多 after the measure word = "and a bit more".

items.en: I work eight hours a day.
items.ruby: 我[wǒ]每天[měi tiān]工作[gōng zuò]八[bā]个[ge]小时[xiǎo shí]。
items.kana: wo meitian gongzuo ba ge xiaoshi
items.romaji: Wǒ měitiān gōngzuò bā ge xiǎoshí.
items.note: How long you do something comes after the verb.

items.ruby: 你[nǐ]什么[shén me]时候[shí hou]来[lái]？
我[wǒ]明天[míng tiān]上午[shàng wǔ]来[lái]。

items.note: 下班以后 = after work.

items.ruby: 吃饭[chī fàn]以前[yǐ qián]洗[xǐ]手[shǒu]。
items.note: 3rd + 3rd tone: xí shǒu.

items.ruby: 洗手间[xǐ shǒu jiān]在[zài]哪儿[nǎ r]？
items.note: 洗手间 is the polite word. 3rd + 3rd tone: xí shǒu.
在 = to be at a place.
这儿 zhèr (north) = 这里 zhèlǐ.

items.ruby: 我[wǒ]在[zài]商店[shāng diàn]门口[mén kǒu]。

items.note: 银行 yínháng: 行 is háng here, not xíng.
3rd + 3rd tone: qíng děng.

items.en: The phone is on the table.
items.ruby: 手机[shǒu jī]在[zài]桌子[zhuō zi]上[shang]。
items.note: The location word goes after the noun: 桌子上 = on the table.
items.pattern: A 在 + noun + 上 / 里

items.en: The keys are in the bag.
The cat is under the bed.
The bank is next to the hospital.
items.ruby: 银行[yín háng]在[zài]医院[yī yuàn]旁边[páng biān]。

items.en: There's a book on the table.
items.kana: zhuozi shang you yi ben shu
items.romaji: Zhuōzi shang yǒu yì běn shū.
items.note: 在: you know the thing and ask where it is. 有: you know the place and say what is there.

items.en: Is there a supermarket near here?
items.ruby: 这儿[zhè r]附近[fù jìn]有[yǒu]超市[chāo shì]吗[ma]？

items.note: Just say thanks.
No word for "to": 去 + place.
回 = go back: 回家, 回国.

items.en: I'll wait for you at the café.
items.ruby: 我[wǒ]在[zài]咖啡馆[kā fēi guǎn]等[děng]你[nǐ]。
items.note: 3rd + 3rd tone: déng nǐ.

items.ruby: 她[tā]在[zài]图书馆[tú shū guǎn]看[kàn]书[shū]。

items.note: 来 = come (towards the speaker), 去 = go. 玩儿 = have fun, hang out.
With 住 the place comes after the verb: 住在 + place.

items.en: Is the airport far from here?
items.ruby: 机场[jī chǎng]离[lí]这儿[zhè r]远[yuǎn]吗[ma]？
items.note: 离 measures distance from a point: A 离 B 远 = A is far from B.
items.pattern: A 离 B 远 / 近

items.note: Verb or adjective + 不 + the same word is another yes / no question; 不 is neutral in it.
3rd + 3rd tone: tíng yuǎn.

items.en: My home is close to the office.
items.kana: wo jia li gongsi hen jin
items.romaji: Wǒ jiā lí gōngsī hěn jìn.

items.en: There are a lot of people here.
items.note: 这里 = 这儿, 那里 = 那儿, 哪里 = 哪儿.

items.ruby: 这个[zhè ge]地方[dì fang]很[hěn]漂亮[piào liang]。

items.note: 银行对面 = opposite the bank.

items.en: What time do you get up every day?
items.ruby: 你[nǐ]每天[měi tiān]几[jǐ]点[diǎn]起床[qǐ chuáng]？

items.en: I have breakfast at half past seven.
items.kana: wo qi dian ban chi zaofan
items.romaji: Wǒ qī diǎn bàn chī zǎofàn.

items.en: I go to work at eight.

items.ruby: 我[wǒ]下午[xià wǔ]六[liù]点[diǎn]下班[xià bān]。
items.note: 上班 = start work / be at work; 下班 = finish work.

items.en: First I have a shower, then I have dinner.
items.ruby: 我[wǒ]先[xiān]洗澡[xǐ zǎo]，然后[rán hòu]吃[chī]晚饭[wǎn fàn]。
items.kana: wo xian xizao ranhou chi wanfan
items.romaji: Wǒ xiān xǐzǎo, ránhòu chī wǎnfàn.
items.note: 3rd + 3rd tone: xí zǎo.

items.en: I go to bed at 11 p.m.
items.ruby: 我[wǒ]晚上[wǎn shang]十一[shí yī]点[diǎn]睡觉[shuì jiào]。
我[wǒ]每天[měi tiān]早上[zǎo shang]跑步[pǎo bù]。

items.note: 3rd + 3rd tone: xí liǎn.

items.ruby: 你[nǐ]中午[zhōng wǔ]在[zài]哪儿[nǎ r]吃饭[chī fàn]？

items.note: 干 gàn (to do) is informal; 做 zuò is neutral.
在 before a verb = the action is going on.
呢 at the end adds "right now".
正在 = right in the middle of.

items.ruby: 妈妈[mā ma]在[zài]打[dǎ]电话[diàn huà]。

items.note: Negate 在 + verb with 没.

items.ruby: 孩子们[hái zi men]在[zài]外面[wài miàn]玩儿[wán r]。

items.note: 有点儿 + adjective = a bit (usually something unwelcome). 3rd + 3rd tone: yóu diǎnr.

items.en: I'll call you back in a little while.
items.ruby: 我[wǒ]一会儿[yí huì r]再[zài]打[dǎ]给[gěi]你[nǐ]。
items.kana: wo yihuir zai da gei ni
items.romaji: Wǒ yíhuìr zài dǎ gěi nǐ.

items.note: 3rd + 3rd tone: dá sǎo.

items.en: What are you doing at the weekend?
items.ruby: 你[nǐ]周末[zhōu mò]做[zuò]什么[shén me]？

items.en: I'm going to see a friend.
items.note: 要 + verb = going to (a plan).

items.ruby: 我们[wǒ men]一起[yì qǐ]去[qù]吧[ba]！
items.note: 一起 yìqǐ: 一 is yì before a 3rd tone.

items.ruby: 不好意思[bù hǎo yì si]，我[wǒ]有[yǒu]事[shì]。
items.note: 不好意思 = sorry (light, everyday); 对不起 is stronger.
